title: Covid-19 Measures
content:
It’s quite unfortunate that the number of corona -Virus cases in Ghana keeps rising .

We extend our condolence to the families, friends, people who have lost their loved ones during this pandemic

We at Sabary Tours believe that the health and safety of our clients is our priority so we will ensure that each person complies to the Covid-19 safety protocols

Let’s wear our nose mask on the bus  and sanitize our hands regularly .Temperature checks for all tourists before you enter the bus

Social distancing amongst tourist on the bus. Let’s be each other’s keeper and let’s help put a stop to the speed of this deadly virus. Lets be each other’s keeper

Thank you for choosing to tour with Sabary Tours. We are looking forward to providing you a lifetime experience.

 

Ghana Considering Another Lockdown Due to An increase in Covid-19 cases

 

Honorable Kojo Oppong Nkrumah, the Information Minister-designate, disclosed today during a press briefing by the Ministry of Information said that there is a likelihood for another lockdown soon due to the increase in Covid -19 cases within the country.

He said: “There’s a possibility of a lockdown and other restrictions. If this trend continues, then yes that is where we are heading. I have to be very clear on that one that more restrictions could be introduced if this trend continues�?

There has been a surge in number of active cases .As at the time of this press briefing the number of active cases  stands at 3, 286 with  six more deaths recorded, taking the number to 367.

 

Accredited Covid-19 test centers in Ghana

 

Due to the surge in numbers of the corona cases across the globe it’s become paramount for both travelers and individuals to get a test done to ascertain their covid-19 status

We have compiled a list of covid-19 centers who have been approved and accredited by the Ghana health Service to conduct this test

Below are laboratories in Ghana that are certified to test for COVID-19

•National Public Health Reference Laboratory

•Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research-030 250 0374

•Kumasi Centre for Collaborative Research-032 206 0351

•Veterinary Services Department - Labone

•Veterinary Services Department - Takoradi- 0571925379

•Public Health Reference Laboratory - Tamale

•Public Health Reference Laboratory - Sekondi Takoradi

•University Health And Allied Sciences Laboratory - Ho 036 219 6122

•MDS-LANCET -East Legon  030 261 0480

•Nyaho Diagnostic Laboratory- Accra 030 708 6490

•Akai House Laboratory- Accra 030 278 4772

•Council for Scientific And Industrial Research -Accra (030 277 7651)

•Leding Medical Laboratory- 030 261 0480

•The Trust Hospital Company Ltd. - 030 276 1974

•Synlab Ghana-Accra 030 276 3580

Emergency Number  112

Source :ghanahealthservice.org

Kindly Note that, fees  vary per institution and are not covered by the Government of Ghana.

The test range from 300.00 -650.00 depending on the institution

Expedited processing is available for an additional fee, typically ranging from 650-750 GHC total.

 

Free Covid-19 test for Ghanaians

 

The Ministry Of Health,under the directive of the government of Ghana has  directed all public health laboratories in Ghana to provide  free Covid-19 test to Ghanaians

The only people required to make payment for the Covid-19 test are travelers
